title: Understanding the Problem
text: You need to select the histogram that best visualizes the distribution of the sample median from $$10$$ random samples.

title: Characteristics of the Sample Median
text: The sample median is less affected by extreme values and tends to be more stable than the mean. Consider how this affects the shape of the distribution.

title: Comparing Distributions
text: Look at the shape of the original distribution and compare it to the options. Which histogram reflects a similar shape but with less variability?

title: Selecting the Correct Histogram
text: Which histogram best represents the distribution of the sample median from $$10$$ samples?
